enabled.title: Enable FiveM / RedM support
enabled.description: Master switch: natives, the Cfx runtime API and every CfxLua feature. Turn it off in projects that are not FiveM or RedM resources.

game.title: Game
game.description: Whose client natives scripts see. Auto reads the game / games directives of the project's fxmanifest.lua files (FiveM when none says).

clientNatives.title: Client natives and client runtime API

serverNatives.title: Server natives and server runtime API

runtimeApi.title: Cfx runtime API (Citizen, events, exports, state bags, json, msgpack, ...)

showDeprecatedAliasesInCompletion.title: Show deprecated native aliases (old names) in completion

showUnnamedNativesInCompletion.title: Show unnamed natives (N_0x...) in completion
showUnnamedNativesInCompletion.description: Hidden natives are still recognised: existing scripts are not flagged.

hints.parameterNames.title: Show parameter names before arguments
hints.parameterNames.description: Before a number, a string, a table, a function or an operation given to a function the plugin knows, as in open(door: 2, fast: true).

hints.localTypes.title: Show the types of local variables

gutter.overrides.title: Gutter: methods that override another one or are overridden

gutter.classes.title: Gutter: classes, and those that have subclasses

gutter.tailCalls.title: Gutter: calls that are returned (tail calls)

inspections.unused.title: Inspection: unused locals, parameters, loop variables and local functions
inspections.unused.description: Fades what is declared and never used, with a fix that removes it or renames it to _. A statement under a ---@suppress RemoveUnusedLocal comment is left alone; every inspection takes its name that way.

inspections.shadowed.title: Inspection: local that hides another local of the same name

inspections.simplifyLocal.title: Inspection: local given nil (local a = nil)

inspections.emptyBody.title: Inspection: for, while or do with an empty body

inspections.duplicateClass.title: Inspection: class declared twice in the project

inspections.deprecated.title: Inspection: use of what a ---@deprecated comment marks

inspections.unresolvedType.title: Inspection: type of a comment that no class or alias declares
inspections.unresolvedType.description: After a comma, a ---@return reads another type: write a description after a # (---@return boolean ok # true, or nil).

inspections.globalLocal.title: Inspection: global that nothing outside its file uses
inspections.globalLocal.description: The first assignment of a global that no other file of the project reads, assigns or defines, with a fix that makes it local. Off by default, as in the JetBrains plugin.

inspections.matchSignature.title: Type safety: arguments that do not match the function they are given to
inspections.matchSignature.description: Missing or extra arguments and arguments of another type than the ---@param of the function; also a call to a method its class does not declare.

inspections.returnType.title: Type safety: return values that do not match ---@return

inspections.assignType.title: Type safety: value assigned to a variable or a field of another type

inspections.undeclaredVariable.title: Type safety: name that nothing declares

format.keepSimpleBlocksInOneLine.title: Formatter: keep a block that holds one statement on one line
format.keepSimpleBlocksInOneLine.description: Reformat Code writes the body of an if, a loop or a function on its own lines. With this option a block with a single statement that is written on one line stays there: if ok then return end. The formatter runs once the plugin is chosen for lua in Settings, Languages & Frameworks, Plugin Formatters.

format.removeSemicolons.title: Formatter: remove the semicolons no statement needs
format.removeSemicolons.description: A semicolon that separates the fields of a table stays, and so does the one before a statement that starts with a parenthesis.

format.spaceAroundAssignment.title: Formatter: space around = and the compound assignments

format.spaceInsideInlineTable.title: Formatter: space inside the braces of a table

format.spaceAfterTableFieldSep.title: Formatter: space after the separator of two table fields

format.alignParameters.title: Formatter: align the parameters written on several lines

format.alignArguments.title: Formatter: align the arguments written on several lines
format.alignArguments.description: Off, an argument that starts a line takes a continuation indent, twice the indent of the editor.

format.alignConsecutiveAssignments.title: Formatter: align the = of assignments that follow one another

format.alignTableFieldAssign.title: Formatter: align the = of the fields of a table

format.continuationIndent.title: Formatter: indent of a line that continues the one before it, in columns
format.continuationIndent.description: An argument, an operand or a chained call that starts a line. 0 takes twice the indent of the editor, as IntelliJ does: 8 columns for an indent of 4.

natives.autoUpdate.title: Check for new natives automatically
natives.autoUpdate.description: Once a day, download the Cfx.re native databases (static.cfx.re, GitHub) if they changed.

events.detectHelpers.title: Detect event helpers automatically
events.detectHelpers.description: Functions whose parameters reach the event name of AddEventHandler / RegisterNetEvent / Trigger*Event are treated as event helpers.

events.helpers.title: Event helpers declared by hand
events.helpers.description: One per line: the function path and its annotation, for example: Legacy.Emit trigger server key(1)

events.aliasFunctions.title: Event alias functions
events.aliasFunctions.description: Functions declaring that a network name and a key are the same event. Comma-separated.

events.reportIgnoredValues.title: Report handlers ignoring some of the values sent

nui.messageKeys.title: NUI message keys
nui.messageKeys.description: Keys of a SendNUIMessage table naming the message, compared by the page (event.data.action). Comma-separated.

nui.fetchFunctions.title: NUI callback functions
nui.fetchFunctions.description: JavaScript functions taking a NUI callback name as first argument, besides the ones detected (a function building the URL from GetParentResourceName() and a parameter). Comma-separated.

nui.listenerFunctions.title: NUI message functions
nui.listenerFunctions.description: JavaScript functions or decorators taking a message name as first argument (useNuiEvent, @OnNuiEvent), besides the ones detected. Comma-separated.

nui.devServerPort.title: NUI dev server port
nui.devServerPort.description: Used by "Switch ui_page to the dev server" when no vite or webpack config declares a port.

values.hints.title: Show magic value hints
values.hints.description: Name the numbers passed to natives (controls, hashes, blips, markers, HUD colours, explosions, animation flags) as hints.

values.blips.title: Magic values: blip sprites and colours

coords.zonesFile.title: Zones file
coords.zonesFile.description: A zones.json in the project (absolute or project-relative path) used for zone hints on coordinates. Empty turns zone hints off.

coords.configTables.title: Config table names
coords.configTables.description: Tables whose coordinates are checked for duplicates. Comma-separated.

perf.throttleMs.title: Interval offered by 'Wait longer between iterations' (ms)

perf.suggestNearOnly.title: Offer the adaptive sleep for loops whose per-frame work only runs near a position

perf.pollingFunctions.title: Functions that never wait and never need to run every frame

perf.minCalls.title: Minimum number of identical calls reported

perf.allLoops.title: Also report loops that don't run every frame

escrow.showStatus.title: Show the Asset Escrow status of resource files
escrow.showStatus.description: Files of resources declaring escrow_ignore show whether they will be encrypted or stay open.

escrow.assumeEscrow.title: Treat every resource as escrowed
escrow.assumeEscrow.description: Also show the status and run the escrow checks in resources without escrow_ignore.
